# Future Solutions Dev

> Future Solutions builds custom web, mobile, SaaS and AI software for businesses in Egypt, the Gulf and worldwide, from real estate platforms to online stores.

Future Solutions Dev is a software agency founded in 2022 and based in Cairo, Egypt. It serves businesses across the Arab world (Egypt, Saudi Arabia, the Gulf) and worldwide, in Arabic and English. Clients own 100% of the code, receive a fixed quote before work starts and see a working link every week.

Contact: info@futuresolutionsdev.com · +201015471713 · https://wa.me/201148371185

## Services

- [Web Development](https://futuresolutionsdev.com/en/services/web): Fast bilingual websites, custom stores and web apps built with Next.js and React, made to rank on Google and convert visitors.
- [Mobile Apps](https://futuresolutionsdev.com/en/services/mobile): iPhone and Android apps from one codebase with Flutter or React Native, with notifications, offline mode and store publishing.
- [SaaS Platforms](https://futuresolutionsdev.com/en/services/saas): Multi-tenant SaaS platforms with subscriptions, Stripe, Paymob and Fawry billing, roles, APIs and reports, from MVP to scale.
- [AI Solutions](https://futuresolutionsdev.com/en/services/ai): AI assistants on your own data, document and voice processing and workflow automation with Claude, GPT, Gemini and open models.
- [Hosting & Operations](https://futuresolutionsdev.com/en/services/hosting): Server setup, automated deployments, monitoring and backups on VPS or AWS, Google Cloud and Azure, with costs you can predict.
- [Cybersecurity](https://futuresolutionsdev.com/en/services/security): Penetration testing, AI security testing, server hardening, dependency audits and Cloudflare protection, with a clear report of every fix.

Core technologies: Next.js, React, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui, Framer Motion, GSAP, TanStack Query, SWR, Zustand, Redux Toolkit, React Hook Form, Zod, Node.js, Bun, Hono, Express, NestJS, Go, Laravel, PHP, .NET, PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB, MongoDB, REST, OpenAPI, GraphQL, tRPC, Flutter, Dart, React Native, Expo, Firebase Auth, Firebase Cloud Messaging, Crashlytics, WebSockets, Google Play, App Store, Drizzle, Prisma, Redis, BullMQ, Stripe, Paymob, Fawry, Socket.IO, WhatsApp Business API, Claude, GPT, Gemini, Kimi, GLM, Llama, Mistral, pgvector, LangChain, Whisper, Python, FastAPI, Hetzner, DigitalOcean, Contabo, AWS, Google Cloud, Azure, Vercel, Netlify, Nginx, PM2, systemd, Docker, GitHub Actions, Uptime Kuma, Better Stack, Grafana, Prometheus, Cloudflare R2, Amazon S3, BunXRay, OWASP ZAP, Burp Suite, Cloudflare, Let's Encrypt, Fail2ban, UFW, Snyk, Dependabot, Sentry.

## Frequently asked questions

- **How much does a project cost?** It depends on the scope: a landing site is not an e-commerce platform. After one free consultation you get a fixed quote with a clear scope. The price you approve is the price you pay.
- **How long does it take?** A typical first version ships in 4 to 8 weeks depending on scope, with a working link you can see every week from week one, as described in how we work.
- **I have an idea but I'm not technical. Where do I start?** That is exactly what the free consultation is for. Tell us the business goal in your own words, and we translate it into what is possible, what it costs and how long it takes.
- **What do you need from me to get started?** Three things: describe your goal in plain words, share examples you like (any site or app), and be available for quick decisions when we ask. We handle design, content structure and everything technical. Send us your idea.
- **Who owns the code?** You do, 100%. Code, design and data are yours, delivered with documentation. There is no lock-in: any developer can continue the work after us.
- **My idea is confidential. How is it protected?** We sign an NDA before you share any details. It is standard practice for us. Your idea, data and business information stay confidential whether or not we end up working together.
- **Who pays for hosting and running costs?** Hosting and domain are registered in your name and stay yours. Typical costs are known upfront with no hidden markup. We set everything up and can manage it for you through our hosting and operations service.
- **Do I pay everything upfront?** No. Payment is split into installments tied to delivery milestones you can see and test. You pay for progress you have verified, not for promises.
- **Do you work with clients outside Egypt?** Yes. We work fully remotely in Arabic and English, and our platforms ship bilingual when your market needs it. See our work.
- **What happens after launch?** We don't disappear. Support and maintenance plans keep your platform fast, secure and up to date, and we are there for the next feature when you are ready.
- **I already have an old website or system. Rebuild or improve?** We assess it first. Sometimes targeted improvements get you 80% of the value at a fraction of the cost; sometimes a rebuild is genuinely cheaper in the long run. We tell you which, with reasons, before you spend.
